proposed_widenings.name: unconditional_phase (ActivationPhase)
proposed_widenings.justification: Plane Shift has no attack roll and no saving throw. It transports willing creatures with no resolution gate. The activation family requires every phase to be attack_roll or save_gate, which makes it impossible to honestly encode any spell that simply applies an effect to willing targets without a roll.
proposed_widenings.evidence: You and up to eight willing creatures who link hands in a circle are transported to a different plane of existence.

proposed_widenings.name: transport_exile
proposed_widenings.justification: The v4 taxonomy lists transport_exile as an effect atom but it is absent from types.ts Effect union. Without it, the transport mechanic cannot be expressed even if a suitable phase existed. DamageEffect | NoneEffect does not cover interplanar or intradimensional movement.
proposed_widenings.evidence: You and up to eight willing creatures who link hands in a circle are transported to a different plane of existence.

notes: The landing-spot determination ('as determined by the DM') is secondary DM-agenda, but the core mechanic — deterministic transport of willing creatures to another plane — is a genuine mechanical effect. The structural gap is twofold: (1) no activation phase kind for unconditional willing-target application, and (2) transport_exile missing from the Effect union despite being in the v4 atom inventory. The same structural gap applies to Misty Step, Dimension Door, Teleport, and similar unconditional-transport spells.
